WITH country_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) as avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT 
  country,
  avg_points,
  avg_wins,
  avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_stats) as avg_wins_diff
FROM country_stats
